provenance.source: CRA T4127 Payroll Deductions Formulas (current edition); CRA indexation adjustment for personal income tax and benefit amounts, 2026; Bill C-4 (lowest rate cut to 14% from 01-07-2025)
provenance.notes: Figures transcribed from the build specification. NOT machine-verified against T4127. Verify every value before shipping.

verificationTodo: Confirm the 2026 federal brackets against the CRA indexation page (2.0% indexation factor).
canadaEmploymentAmount - 1500 is the 2025 amount of 1471 indexed at 2.0% and rounded. Confirm against T4127.
medical.fixedThreshold - 2891 is the 2025 amount of 2834 indexed at 2.0%. Confirm against T4127.
omissions: Tax year 2025 is not shipped. If it is added, the lowest federal rate is the blended 14.5% and the credit valuation rate for 2025 is also 14.5%.
Spousal, eligible dependant, age, pension income, disability and tuition credits are not modelled in v1.
Quebec is out of scope - it levies its own provincial return and the federal abatement applies.
The alternative minimum tax is not modelled.

brackets.note: Lowest rate is 14% for 2026. It was 15% before 01-07-2025 and blends to 14.5% for the 2025 tax year only.

basicPersonalAmount.note: Linear phase-out across the fourth bracket, based on net income. Inside the phase-out band the marginal rate is effectively 29.29%, not 29%.

cpp.legalRef: CPP Act s. 8, 11.1; CRA T4127 s. 5
cpp.note: The base portion (4.95%) is a non-refundable credit. The enhanced portion (1.00%) and all of CPP2 are a DEDUCTION from income at line 22215, not a credit.

ei.legalRef: EI Act s. 66-67; CRA T4127 s. 6
ei.note: Rate outside Quebec. EI premiums are a non-refundable credit valued at the lowest rate.

canadaEmploymentAmount.note: Credit base is the lesser of this amount and employment income.

medical.note: Only the excess of eligible expenses over the LESSER of 3% of net income and the fixed threshold is creditable.

donations.note: First 200 at the lowest rate, the remainder at 29%, except that donations are credited at 33% to the extent taxable income sits in the top bracket.

inputSchema.label: Employment income (gross, per month)
inputSchema.help: Gross pay before deductions, month by month. Leave a month blank if you had no employment income then - a partial year is taxed on the actual total and is never annualised.

inputSchema.label: Income tax withheld on each pay (per month)
inputSchema.help: Federal plus provincial tax deducted at source, from your pay stub. Used only for the final refund or balance owing.

inputSchema.label: RRSP contributions
inputSchema.help: Contributions you deduct this year, within your contribution room. A TFSA contribution is NOT deductible.

inputSchema.label: Union and professional dues
inputSchema.help: Annual dues for union membership or a professional body required to keep your professional status. Not initiation fees or licences you are not required to hold.

inputSchema.label: Childcare expenses
inputSchema.help: Daycare, nurseries, day camps and caregivers so you could work. Per-child annual limits and a two-thirds-of-earned-income limit apply and are NOT enforced in v1 - enter the amount you can actually claim.

inputSchema.label: Moving expenses
inputSchema.help: Only for a move that brought you at least 40 km closer to a new work or study location, and only against income earned at the new location.

inputSchema.label: Charitable donations
inputSchema.help: Gifts to registered charities with an official receipt. A GoFundMe or a political contribution does not qualify here.

inputSchema.label: Eligible medical expenses
inputSchema.help: Total eligible expenses paid. Only the excess over the lesser of 3% of net income and the fixed annual threshold produces a credit.
